bio.text: Michael McGuire is the Republican candidate for New Jersey's 3rd Congressional District, where Democrat Herb Conaway is the incumbent.
McGuire, 47, is a family law attorney and an officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve who lives in Freehold Township.
He served four years in the Marine Corps before joining the New York City Police Department, where he was a first responder on September 11, 2001.
He is also a small-business advisor and tax practitioner, and this is his first run for office.
